visual_description: A thick, coiled orange data cable with reinforced, weather-sealed connectors. It is shown plugged into the side of the Handheld LiDAR Scanner and leading toward a rugged laptop. The bright orange color ensures it isn't tripped over in the dusty Morrison terrain.

constraints.logic: The physical tether required for high-bandwidth data transfers at basecamp.
constraints.background: The edge of a canvas field tent with a folding table.
